The Creed of Auril

Faction information for the Cult of Auril in Icewind Dale. DM Reference only.

Auril, the Frostmaiden

Auril is a lesser deity representing the bleak, cold, dangerous fury of winter. Haughty, overbearing, mercurial, uncaring, and fickle — she is not benevolent. Like the winter she controls, she is cold, dangerous, and unpredictable.

Motto: Beauty kept in all its grace.
Symbol: A six-pointed snowflake. Cult members carve crude versions into wooden poles, walls, and the undersides of tables. Higher-ranked members carry a piece of black ice with Auril's symbol carved into it.

It's a Church, Not a Cult

Auril is a true deity. In a pantheistic society, it's not abnormal for people to worship multiple deities. A priestess walking around in ceremonial vestments bearing Auril's symbol will not immediately be assumed evil. The most visible member of the Church of Auril is often the priestess or acolyte who travels from town to town offering succor to those who suffer in the cold.

It's Also a Cult

The Cult of Auril exists to exalt, placate, and strengthen the Frostmaiden's influence. In Icewind Dale the cult has been consistently gaining members since the beginning of the Rime. Membership in Icewind Dale: 350+.

Cultists believe it is their duty to show Ten-Towns that worship of the Frostmaiden is the only act that can redeem the world. Low-level cultists use bribery, violence, and blackmail to keep residents in line. Icebringers and coldwinds curry favor with speakers through manipulation and political pressure.

The Four Tenets of Faith

Cruelty. Compassion only highlights weaknesses ripe for exploitation. Cruelty is the armor you need. "Compassion makes you vulnerable. Let cruelty be the knife that keeps your enemies at bay."

Endurance. Perseverance is a testament to itself. "Exist as long as you can, by whatever means you can. Only by enduring can you outlast your enemies."

Isolation. Count on no one else. Only self-reliance can lead to self-actualization. "In solitude you can understand and harness your full potential. Depending on others makes you weak."

Preservation. Auril's most devout followers know this tenet to be the most important — wrap all that is beautiful in a blanket of preserving ice. "Every flake of snow is unique, and that which is unique must be preserved."

Cult Greetings

Active cultists use specific phrases to identify each other in crowds:

  • Greeting: "The frigid veil persists."
  • Response: "All the world in winter's white."
  • Parting: "May her blessing chill you."

Mottos

  • "Only we can preserve the unspoiled beauty of the world."
  • "Loyalty to winter will preserve the world."

Holidays

  • Midwinter Night — holiest night for Icedawn worshipers. Those born on this day are said to be blessed by the Frostmaiden.
  • Auril's Blesstide — the first frost.
  • The Coming Storm — ritualized observance of the first day of winter; priests call forth an icestorm.
  • The Last Storm — marks the last day of winter.

Cult Ranks

RankCRPrerequisiteKey Benefit
Spite1/8Pledge to spread word of AurilCold Faith, Surge of Cruelty
Tempest1/2Provide food and shelter to another memberEndurance Everlasting
Darkhand2Recruit and train new membersBlack Ice Ring, Boon of Frost
Coldwind4Make pilgrimage to SolsticeBlessing of the Frostmaiden, spells
Icebringer6Sacrifice a humanoid to elevate AurilWord of the Frostmaiden
Nix Mater9Begin transformation into Winter HagStaff of Withering, possible Exarch

Overall Structure

One coldwind permanently oversees each Ten-Town settlement. 3-4 darkhands report to each coldwind. Each darkhand manages 2 tempests, who each oversee 2-3 spites. Icebringers travel between 2-3 settlements. At the apex are three Nix Mater (snow mothers) known as Fury, Anger, and Wrath.

Key Benefits

Cold Faith: Resistance to cold damage; advantage on saves against charmed and frightened.

Surge of Cruelty (recharge short/long rest): When hitting with an attack that isn't a critical hit, can turn it into a critical hit.

Endurance Everlasting (Recharge 5-6): Reaction — when taking damage, roll a d6 and subtract from damage.

Blessing of the Frostmaiden: Eyes become solid blue orbs; immunity to cold; cone of cold 1/day.

Word of the Frostmaiden (recharge long rest): Reaction — when taking damage, cast frost guardians or heat thief at end of attacker's turn.

Cult Activity by Town

Dougan's Hole — The Twenty Stones of Thruun has been surreptitiously used as an Ice Temple. Icebringer Savaa Rubyeye has become more open about ceremonies here. Speaker Edgra Durmoot actively resists — she is an ally.

Bryn Shander — Cult lays low because Sheriff Markham Southwell has been working with a priestess of Amaunator to delegitimize Auril worship. Icebringer Jelenneth Arnuanna has instructed ~50 cultists to lay low.

Easthaven — Cult headquarters in Icewind Dale is a large farmhouse on the edge of town. Coldwind Jia Inbar has ingratiated herself to Speaker Danneth Waylen. She was instrumental in halting the ferry service and in the apprehension of Dzaan.

Bremen — ~15 cultists including Coldwind Allosa Faerwill and 2 darkhands (Harklen and Lerro). The cult knows about the black ice shard carried by the tieflings (Knights of the Black Sword).

Caer-Dineval — Cult recently found out about the Knights of the Black Sword using black ice shards. Coldwind Timmis Welbe may befriend the party and the Knights to play them against each other.

Lonelywood — Frost Druid Ravisin is a loner cultist — no specific rank, doesn't coordinate with icebringers or coldwinds. Will not attack creatures wearing Auril's symbol.

Targos — Cult is trying to infiltrate the militia to undermine Zhentarim intel flowing from Naerth Maxildanarr.

Sephek Kaltro Connection

Sephek Kaltro travels with Torg's caravan, visiting multiple towns. He targets people who have bribed or cheated their way out of participating in the sacrifice lottery. Icebringer Callie Teafellow has instructed him to start targeting smaller towns as well.

Auril's Lair

Auril's divine residence is Winter's Hall in the topmost layer of Pandemonium. On Toril, she keeps a lair on the island of Solstice, somewhere in the Sea of Moving Ice. Only icebringer rank and above know its location. Among the known favored: Sephek Kaltro, Hedrun Arnsfirth, and Bjornhild Solvigsdottir.
